harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: The clause «يبشرهم» is a second khabar (predicate) of the aforementioned mubtadaʾ (subject) «أولئك». The two preposition and its genitive nouns «لهم فيها نعيم» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «نعيم», and the clause «لهم فيها نعيم» is a naʿt (adjective) of «جنات».

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: «خالدين»: ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in the preceding {لَهُمْ}. The preposition «فيها» and the adverb «أبدًا» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the ḥāl «خالدين». The clause «عنده أجر» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن», in the position of the nominative.

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: «أولياء»: second object, accusative. The clause «إن استحبوا» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. The preposition «منكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «يتولهَّم». The clause «ومن يتولهم» is conjoined to the answer of the vocative, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: The clause «اقترفتموها» is a naʿt (adjective) of «أموال». The wāw in «اقترفتموها» is for lengthening (ishbāʿ), with no grammatical position. «أحبَّ» is the khabar (predicate) of kāna. The clause «فتربَّصوا» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: The lām in «لقد» occurs in the answer to an implied oath. As for «ويوم»: the wāw is a conjunction, and «يوم» is a noun conjoined to the position of (مواطن), attached to (mutaʿalliq) what that is attached to: an adverb of time is conjoined, without the intermediary (في), to an adverb of place that is genitive by it. The implied form is: "and Allah helped you on the day of Ḥunayn". «إذ»: an adverb of time, badal (substitute) from «يوم», and the clause «أعجبتكم» is muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct). «شيئا»: standing in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "any availing, little or much". As for «بما رحبت»: «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the maṣdar (verbal noun) is genitive, attached to «ضاقت». «مدبرين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the tāʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: The preposition «على رسوله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أنزل». The clause «لم تروها» is a naʿt (adjective) of «جنودا». The clause «وذلك جزاء الكافرين» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: The clause «والله غفور» is resumptive. «رحيم» is a second khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: The clause «إنما المشركون نجس» is the answer to the vocative, resumptive. The clause «فلا يقربوا» is conjoined to the resumptive clause «إنما المشركون نجس». «هذا»: a naʿt (adjective) interpreted as a derived word, i.e. "their aforementioned year". The clause «إن شاء» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: «دين» is accusative by removal of the preposition, the bāʾ. The preposition «عن يد» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «يعطوا», and the clause «وهم صاغرون» is a ḥāl from the wāw in «يعطوا».

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: «عزير ابن» is mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and likewise «المسيح ابن الله». The preposition «بأفواههم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «قولهم». The clause «يضاهئون» is a ḥāl from the pronoun in «قولهم». The clause «قاتلهم الله» is resumptive. «أنى» is an interrogative noun, a ḥāl. The clause «يؤفكون» is a ḥāl from the hāʾ of «قاتلهم».

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: «أربابا» is the second object. The preposition «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «أربابا». The clause «وما أمروا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «اتخذوا». «لا إله إلا هو»: «لا» is the lā of generic negation, «إله» is its noun, and the khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "deserving of worship". «إلا» is for restriction. «هو» is a badal (substitute) from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in the omitted khabar, and the clause is a second naʿt of «إله». «سبحانه» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) whose governing word is omitted, its implied form being "we glorify"; its clause is resumptive. The preposition «عما» is composed of the preposition «عن» and the maṣdariyya «ما», and the genitive maṣdar (verbal noun) is attached to the implied "we glorify".

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: The clause «يريدون» is resumptive. The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يطفئوا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «يريد», and the maṣdar «أن يتم» is the mafʿūl bihi of «يأبى». The implied form of the speech is: "Allah wants nothing but the completion", because the emptied exception (al-istithnāʾ al-mufarragh) is preceded by a negation. As for «ولو كره»: the wāw is circumstantial; the wāw conjoined it to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "He completes His light in every state, even in this state", and this is for exhausting all states. The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. The clause «ولو كره الكافرون» is a ḥāl from the aforementioned completion.

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: The clause «والذين يكنزون» is resumptive. The clause «فبشِّرهم» is the khabar (predicate) of «الذين»; the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and the fāʾ was attached to the khabar because the relative noun is likened to a conditional.

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: «يوم» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied «يُعَذَّبون», and the clause of the implied verb is resumptive. The nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of «يحمى» is a pronoun, its implied form being "it", referring to the fuel. The two preposition and its genitive nouns are attached to «يحمى». The clause «هذا ما كنزتم» is the content of speech (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted verb of saying, in the position of the accusative, and the clause of the omitted saying is conjoined to the clause «تُكوى»; the implied form is: "and it will be said: this is what you hoarded". The clause «فذوقوا» is conjoined to the clause «هذا ما كنزتم», in the position of the accusative, and it is part of the completion of the saying.

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: «اثنا»: the khabar (predicate) of «إن», nominative with alif because it is treated like the dual. «عشر» is a part indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa with no grammatical position, and «شهرا» is a tamyīz (specification). The preposition after it is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «اثنا عشر». The clause «منها أربعة حرم» is a naʿt of «اثنا عشر». The clause «ذلك الدين» is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and likewise the clause «فلا تظلموا». «كافة»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «المشركين». The kāf in «كما» is a noun meaning "like", standing in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "a fighting like their fighting of you", and «ما» is maṣdariyya. The interpreted maṣdar «أن الله مع المتقين» stands in place of the two objects of «علم».

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: The preposition «في الكفر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «زيادة». The clause «يضل به الذين» is a second khabar (predicate). The clause «يُحِلُّونه» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الذين». The clause «زُيِّن لهم سوء» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:38-38.t: «ما لكم»: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate), and the conditional clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «لكم». The preposition «من الآخرة» is attached to a ḥāl from «الحياة». The clause «أرضيتم» is resumptive, and the clause «فما متاع الحياة» is resumptive; «ما» is inoperative because its negation is cancelled by «إلا».

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: «عذابا»: standing in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar), the maṣdar (verbal noun) being تعذيب. «غيركم»: a naʿt (adjective) of «قوما»; «غير» is indefinite even when put in construct, because it is deeply vague. «شيئا»: standing in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq, i.e. "and you will not harm Him, with any harm, little or much".

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: «إذ» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نصره». «ثاني»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object of «أخرجه», and «اثنين» is muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct), genitive with yāʾ because it is treated like the dual. «إذ هما» is a badal (substitute) from the first «إذ», and «إذ يقول» is a badal from the second «إذ»; the closeness of the times puts them in the position of a single time. «هي العليا»: a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position. The clause «وكلمة الله هي العليا» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: «خفافا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «انفروا». The clause «إن كنتم» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: The clause «ولكن بَعُدت» is conjoined to the clause «لو كان عرضا», and the clause «وسيحلفون» is conjoined to the clause «ولكن بَعُدت». The conditional clause and its apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) are the answer to the oath, with no grammatical position, and the oath is indicated by «سيحلفون». The oath clause with its answer is the content of speech (maqūl al-qawl), i.e. "saying". The clause «يُهْلِكون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «سيحلفون». The clause «إنهم لكاذبون» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the hamza of «إن» is given kasra because of the presence of the lām in the khabar of «إن».

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: «لِمَ»: the lām is a preposition, and «ما» is an interrogative noun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; its alif was dropped because the preposition is joined to it. The preposition is attached to «أذنت», and the preposition «لهم» is attached to «أذنت». It is permissible for two prepositions of a single form to be attached to the verb «أذنت» because their meanings differ: the first is for giving the reason, the second for conveying. The clause «أذنت» is resumptive. The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يتبين» is genitive by «حتى», attached to an implied verb, i.e. "why did you not refrain from giving them permission".

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يجاهدوا» is accusative by removal of the preposition (في). The clause «والله عليم» is resumptive, and the preposition «بالمتقين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «عليم».

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: The clause «فهم يترددون» is conjoined to the clause «ارتابت», and the preposition «في ريبهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يترددون».

harrat-mujtaba:46-46.t: The clause «ولو أرادوا» is resumptive, and the clause «ولكن كره» is conjoined to the clause «ولو أرادوا», with no grammatical position. The nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of «قيل» is the pronoun of the maṣdar (verbal noun).

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: «خبالا» is the second object. The clause «يبغونكم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «أوضعوا», in the position of the accusative, i.e. "they hastened, being seekers". The clause «وفيكم سماعون» is a ḥāl from the fāʿil of «يبغونكم», in the position of the accusative. The kāf in «يبغونكم» is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "they seek for you".

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: The lām in «لقد» occurs in the answer to an implied oath. The verb is a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on a ḍamma implied on the dropped alif, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن جاء» is genitive by «حتى», attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قلَّبوا». The clause «وهم كارهون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of «ظهر».

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: The verb «لا تَفْتِنِّي» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) with sukūn, and the second nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya). «ألا» is a particle of alerting. The clause «سقطوا» is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the clause «وإن جهنم لمحيطة» is resumptive. The preposition «بالكافرين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «محيطة».

harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: The clause «ويتولَّوا» is conjoined to the clause «يقولوا», and the clause «وهم فرحون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «يتولوا», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: The relative «ما» is the fāʿil (agent) of «يصيبنا». The clause «هو مَوْلانا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الله». The clause «فليتوكل» is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and the lām is the jussive lām of command.

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: «إلا» is a particle of restriction. «إحدى» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «ونحن نتربص» is conjoined to the content of speech (maqūl al-qawl). The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يصيبكم» is the mafʿūl bihi of «نتربص». The clause «فتربصوا» is resumptive, and the clause «إنا معكم متربصون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:53-53.t: «طَوْعًا» is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial). The clause «لن يتقبل منكم» is resumptive within the scope of the saying, and likewise the clause «إنكم كنتم قوما».

harrat-mujtaba:54-54.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تقبل» is accusative by removal of the preposition (مِنْ). The maṣdar «أنهم كفروا» is the fāʿil (agent) of «منعهم». The clause «وهم كسالى» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «يأتون». The clause «وهم كارهون» is a ḥāl from the wāw in «ينفقون».

harrat-mujtaba:55-55.t: The object of «يريد الله» is omitted, i.e. "their disgrace". The genitive maṣdar (verbal noun) «ليعذبهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يريد». The clause «وهم كافرون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «تزهق».

harrat-mujtaba:56-56.t: The clause «إنهم لمنكم» is the answer to the oath, and the oath clause with its answer is the content of speech (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied verb of saying, which is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «يحلفون», i.e. "saying: they are of you". The clause «وما هم منكم» is a ḥāl from the noun of «إنَّ», in the position of the accusative. The clause «ولكنهم قوم» is conjoined to the clause «وما هم منكم», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:57-57.t: The conditional clause is a second naʿt (adjective) of the preceding {قَوْمٌ}. The clause «وهم يَجْمحون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «ولَّوا», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:58-58.t: «مَنْ» is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the preposition «منهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). The conditional clause is conjoined to the clause «منهم مَنْ يلمزك». «إذا» is the «إذا» of surprise (fujāʾiyya), and the clause «إذا هم يسخطون» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

harrat-mujtaba:59-59.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أنهم رضوا» is the fāʿil (agent) of an implied «ثبت» ("it were established"). The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e. "it would have been better for them". «حسبنا الله»: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate). The clause «سيؤتينا» is resumptive within the scope of the saying, and likewise the clause «إنَّا إلى الله راغبون». The preposition «إلى الله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «راغبون».

harrat-mujtaba:60-60.t: The preposition «عليها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «العاملين». «قلوبهم» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of «المؤلفة». The preposition «في الرقاب» is conjoined to «للفقراء», attached to what that is attached to, and likewise «في سبيل الله». «والغارمين»: conjoined to «الفقراء». «فريضة»: a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "He has ordained an ordinance"; the preposition is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «فريضة», and the clause "He has ordained an ordinance" is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:61-61.t: «أذن خير» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "he". The clause «يؤمن» is a second khabar of the implied mubtadaʾ. The verb in «يؤمن للمؤمنين» includes the meaning of "accepts/concedes" (يُسَلِّم), and therefore it is made transitive with lām. «ورحمة»: a noun conjoined to the clause «يؤمن», of the type of conjoining a single word to a clause. The preposition «منكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «آمنوا». The clause «لهم عذاب» is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «الذين».

harrat-mujtaba:62-62.t: The answer to the oath «يحلفون» is omitted, i.e. "it will certainly be such-and-such". The clause «والله ورسوله أحق» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «يحلفون», in the position of the accusative. The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يرضوه» is accusative by removal of the preposition, the bāʾ. The pronoun in «يرضوه» is singular, whereas agreement is the base rule, because the implied form is: "and the matter of Allah and His Messenger is more deserving that they should please Him"; pleasing Allah is pleasing His Messenger, and each of them entails the other. The clause «إن كانوا مؤمنين» is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:63-63.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) stands in place of the two objects of «علم». «مَنْ»: a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «يحادد» is the khabar (predicate); the conditional clause with its apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is the khabar of «أنَّ». The fāʾ in «فأنَّ» is connective (rābiṭa), and the interpreted maṣdar «فأن له نار جهنم» is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "his matter is that the fire of Hell is his", and the clause is the apodosis. «خالدا»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «يحادد», and the preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خالدا». The clause «ذلك الخزي» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:64-64.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تنزل» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «قل» is resumptive. The clause «إن الله مخرج» is resumptive within the scope of the saying. «ما»: the mafʿūl bihi of «مُخْرِج».

harrat-mujtaba:65-65.t: The lām in «لئن» paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa), and the lām in «ليقولُن» occurs in the answer to the oath. The verb is an imperfect verb, nominative by the presence of the nūn, which was dropped because of the succession of identical letters; the wāw, dropped because of the meeting of two vowelless letters, is the fāʿil (agent), and the nūn is for emphasis. The preposition «بالله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تستهزئون».

harrat-mujtaba:66-66.t: The two clauses «قد كفرتم» and «إِنْ نَعْفُ» are resumptive, with no grammatical position. The maṣdar (verbal noun) «بأنهم كانوا» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نُعذِّب».

harrat-mujtaba:67-67.t: The clause «بعضهم من بعض» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject), the clause «يأمرون» is a second khabar, and the clause «نسوا» is a third khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:68-68.t: «نار» is the second object, and «خالدين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the preceding nouns. The clause «هي حسبهم» is a ḥāl from «نار جهنم». The clause «ولعنهم الله» is conjoined to the clause «وعد الله», and the clause «ولهم عذاب» is conjoined to the clause «لعنهم الله».

harrat-mujtaba:69-69.t: The preposition «كالذين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "they are like those who". The clause «كانوا أشد» is explicative of the likeness mentioned. «قوة» is a tamyīz (specification), and likewise «أموالا». The kāf in «كما» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is maṣdariyya, i.e. "an enjoyment like the enjoyment". The preposition «بخلاقهم» is attached to «استمتع». The kāf in «كالذي» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq, i.e. "you plunged a plunging like their plunging". The clause «أولئك حبطت» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. «هم» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:70-70.t: «قوم»: a badal (substitute) from the relative noun. The clause «أتتهم رسلهم» is explicative of the aforementioned news. The genitive maṣdar (verbal noun) «ليظلمهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied khabar (predicate) of kāna, "intending", and the lām is the lām of denial (juḥūd). The clause «ولكن كانوا» is conjoined to the clause «ما كان». «أنفسهم»: an object placed before its verb.

harrat-mujtaba:71-71.t: The clause «بعضهم أولياء» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «المؤمنون», and the clause «يأمرون» is a second khabar. The clause «أولئك سيرحمهم» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:72-72.t: «جنات» is the second object, and «خالدين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the believers. The preposition «في جنات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a second naʿt (adjective) of «مساكن», i.e. "being in gardens". The clause «ورضوان من الله أكبر» is resumptive. The preposition «من الله» is attached to a naʿt of «رضوان»; beginning with an indefinite noun is permissible because it is qualified by the preposition and its genitive noun.

harrat-mujtaba:73-73.t: The clause «ومأواهم جهنم» is conjoined to «جاهد الكفار». The one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, and the clause «وبئس المصير» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:74-74.t: «كلمة» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن أغناهم» is the object of «نقم». «يَكُ»: an imperfect abrogating verb (nāsikh), jussive (majzūm) with a sukūn implied on the nūn, which was dropped for lightening; its noun is a pronoun, its implied form being "it", i.e. seeking repentance. The preposition «لهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خيرا». «من ولي»: mubtadaʾ (subject), with «مِنْ» redundant (zāʾida); the preposition «في الأرض» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «ولي». The clause «وما لهم من ولي» is conjoined to the clause «يعذبهم», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:75-75.t: The lām in «لئن» paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa), and «إنْ» is conditional. The clause «لئن آتانا» is explicative of the covenant. The clause «لَنَصَّدَّقَنَّ» is the answer to the oath, with no grammatical position, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the answer to the oath.

harrat-mujtaba:76-76.t: The clause «فلما آتاهم» is conjoined to {لَئِنْ آتَانَا}, with no grammatical position. «لمَّا» is a particle of "occurrence upon occurrence" (wujūb li-wujūb). The clause «بخلوا» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position. The clause «وهم معرضون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «تَوَلَّوا».

harrat-mujtaba:77-77.t: «نفاقا» is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The preposition «في قلوبهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «نفاقا», and the preposition «إلى يوم» is attached to «أعقبهم». «ما وعدوه»: the second object of «أخلف». The clause «أخلفوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative, and «ما» is maṣdariyya; likewise «ما» in «بما كانوا». The genitive interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is conjoined to the preceding maṣdar and is attached to what that is attached to.

harrat-mujtaba:78-78.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) stands in place of the two objects of «علم», and the second maṣdar is conjoined to the preceding maṣdar.

harrat-mujtaba:79-79.t: The relative noun is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and its khabar (predicate) is the clause «سخر الله منهم». The preposition «من المؤمنين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «المطَّوعين», and the preposition «في الصدقات» is attached to «يلمزون». The clause «ولهم عذاب» is conjoined to the clause «سخر الله منهم».

harrat-mujtaba:80-80.t: «سبعين» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «مرة» is a tamyīz (specification). The clause «ذلك بأنهم» is resumptive, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «بأنهم كفروا» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:81-81.t: «خلاف»: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مقعدهم». The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يجاهدوا» is the object of «كره». «حَرًّا» is a tamyīz (specification). The conditional clause is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:82-82.t: «ما» in «بما» is a relative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (verbal noun) «جزاء». The clause «فليضحكوا» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. «قليلا» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and likewise «كثيرا». «جزاء» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).

harrat-mujtaba:83-83.t: The clause «فاستأذنوك» is conjoined to «رجعك», and the clause «فقل» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). «أبدًا» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. The clause «إنكم رضيتم» is resumptive within the scope of the saying. «أول»: stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The clause «فاقعدوا» is conjoined to the clause «رضيتم»; conjoining a performative (inshāʾ) to a statement (khabar) is permissible.

harrat-mujtaba:84-84.t: The preposition «منهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «أحد», and the clause «مات» is a second naʿt of «أحد». The clause «وهم فاسقون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «ماتوا».

harrat-mujtaba:85-85.t: The clause «إنما يريد الله» is resumptive. The clause «وهم كافرون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in «أنفسهم».

harrat-mujtaba:86-86.t: «أن آمنوا»: «أن» is explicative, and the clause «آمنوا» is explicative; it is preceded by a verb that has the meaning of saying without its letters. The clause «نَكُنْ» is the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if you leave us, we will be".

harrat-mujtaba:87-87.t: «رضوا»: a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on a ḍamma implied on the yāʾ, which was dropped because of the meeting of two vowelless letters after it was made vowelless. The clause «فهم لا يفقهون» is conjoined to the clause «طبع», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:88-88.t: «لكن» is a particle of qualification (istidrāk), and the clause after it is resumptive. The clause «لهم الخيرات» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «أولئك». The clause «وأولئك لهم الخيرات» is conjoined to the clause «جاهدوا».

harrat-mujtaba:89-89.t: «خالدين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in {لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٍ}, and the preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خالدين».

harrat-mujtaba:90-90.t: The clause «سيصيب الذين» is resumptive. The preposition «منهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «كفروا».

harrat-mujtaba:91-91.t: «حرج» is the noun of laysa. «إذا نصحوا»: adverbial and conditional, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the content of the implied apodosis, i.e. "when they are sincere to Allah, the blame is removed". The conditional clause is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. «من سبيل»: mubtadaʾ (subject), and «مِنْ» is redundant (zāʾida) because it enters an indefinite noun and is preceded by a negation. The clause «ما على المحسنين من سبيل» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «والله غفور».

harrat-mujtaba:92-92.t: «ما» in «إذا ما» is redundant (zāʾida). The conditional clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the nominal relative, with no grammatical position. The clause «قلت» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the kāf in «أتوك», in the position of the accusative, i.e. "when they came to you while you were saying". The clause «تولَّوا» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). The clause «وأعينهم تفيض» is a ḥāl from the wāw in «تولَّوا», and «حزنا» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). The maṣdar (verbal noun) «ألا يجدوا» is accusative by removal of the preposition, the lām, i.e. "because of not finding what they could spend".

harrat-mujtaba:93-93.t: The clause «وهم أغنياء» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «يستأذنونك». The clause «رضوا» is resumptive, and the clause «فهم لا يعلمون» is conjoined to the clause «طبع».

harrat-mujtaba:94-94.t: «إذا» is purely adverbial, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يعتذرون». The preposition «من أخباركم» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of the implied second object, i.e. "some part of your news". The clause «لن نؤمن» is resumptive within the scope of the saying, and likewise the clause «قد نبأنا الله». The clause «وسيرى» is conjoined to the clause «نبَّأنا».

harrat-mujtaba:95-95.t: «إذا» is purely adverbial, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يحلفون». The clause «فأعرضوا» is resumptive, and the clause «مأواهم جهنم» is conjoined to the resumptive clause «إنهم رجس». «جزاء»: a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an implied governing word, i.e. "they are recompensed with a recompense".

harrat-mujtaba:96-96.t: The clause «فإن ترضوا» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:97-97.t: «كفرا» is a tamyīz (specification), and the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أَلا يعلموا» is accusative by removal of the preposition, the bāʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:98-98.t: The two objects of «يتخذ» are the relative «ما» and «مغرما». The clause «عليهم دائرة» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:99-99.t: The two objects of «يتخذ» are the relative «ما» and «قربات». The adverb «عند» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «قربات». «صلوات»: conjoined to «قربات». The clause «سيدخلهم الله» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:100-100.t: The preposition «من المهاجرين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the mubtadaʾ (subject). The preposition «بإحسان» is attached to a ḥāl from the fāʿil (agent) of «اتبعوهم». «خالدين»: a ḥāl from the pronoun in «لهم», and the preposition «فيها» is attached to «خالدين», and likewise the adverb «أبدا». The clause «ذلك الفوز» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:101-101.t: The preposition «من الأعراب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the relative «مَنْ». The preposition «ومن أهل المدينة» is attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "a people being of the people of…". The clause «مردوا» is a naʿt (adjective) of the implied «قوم». The clause «قوم من أهل المدينة» is conjoined to the clause «منافقون ممن حولكم». The clause «لا تعلمهم» is a ḥāl from the fāʿil (agent) of «مردوا». The clause «نحن نعلمهم» is resumptive, and the clause «سنعذبهم» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. «مرتين» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

harrat-mujtaba:102-102.t: «وآخرون»: mubtadaʾ (subject); its khabar (predicate) is the clause «خلطوا». The clause «وآخرون اعترفوا خلطوا» is conjoined to the clause «ومن أهل المدينة قوم مردوا». The clause «اعترفوا» is a naʿt (adjective) of «آخرون». The clause «عسى الله أن يتوب عليهم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «خلطوا». The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يتوب» is the khabar of «عسى».

harrat-mujtaba:103-103.t: The clause «تطهرهم» is a naʿt (adjective) of «صدقة», and the clause «إنَّ صلاتك سكن» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:104-104.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن الله ...» stands in place of the two objects of «علم». The pronoun «هو» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of «أنَّ». The second maṣdar «وأن الله هو التواب» is conjoined to the preceding maṣdar, in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:105-105.t: The clause «فسيرى الله» is conjoined to the clause «اعملوا», in the position of the accusative, and the clause «ستردُّون» is conjoined to the clause «فسيرى».

harrat-mujtaba:106-106.t: «وآخرون»: mubtadaʾ (subject), and «مُرْجَوْنَ» is its naʿt (adjective). The clause «وآخرون مرجون» is conjoined to the clause {وَآخَرُونَ اعْتَرَفُوا} in verse (102). The preposition «لأمر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مرجون». «إما» is a particle of detailing, and the clause «إما يعذبهم» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ «آخرون».

harrat-mujtaba:107-107.t: «ضرارا» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "to harm their brothers". The khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «الذين» is omitted, its implied form being "will be punished". «وليحلفن إن أردنا إلا الحسنى»: the wāw is resumptive, and the lām occurs in the answer to an implied oath. It is an imperfect verb, nominative by the presence of the nūn, which was dropped because of the succession of identical letters; the wāw, dropped because of the meeting of two vowelless letters, is the fāʿil (agent), and the nūn is for emphasis. «إن» is negating, «إلا» is for restriction, and «الحسنى» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «ووالله ليحلفن» is resumptive, and the clause «ليحلفن» is the answer to the oath. The clause «إن أردنا» is the answer to the second oath, expressed by the swearing. The hamza of «إنَّ» is given kasra after «يشهد» because of the presence of the lām in the khabar, and the clause is the answer to an oath, on the basis that «يشهد» is made to include the meaning of an oath.

harrat-mujtaba:108-108.t: The lām in «لَمسجد» is the lām of inception (ibtidāʾ). The two preposition and its genitive nouns «على التقوى» and «مِنْ أول» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أسس»; beginning with an indefinite noun is permissible because it is qualified. «أحق»: the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «مسجد». The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تقوم» is accusative by removal of the preposition, the bāʾ. The clause «فيه رجال» is a naʿt (adjective) of «مسجد».

harrat-mujtaba:109-109.t: «أفمن»: the hamza is for interrogation, and the fāʾ is resumptive. «مَنْ» is a relative, mubtadaʾ (subject), and «خير» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. «أم» is a conjunction, and the second «مَنْ» is conjoined to the first «مَنْ». The clause «والله لا يهدي» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:110-110.t: «إلا أن تقطع»: «إلا» is a particle of exception; the verb is an imperfect verb in the accusative, its original form being تتقطع. The maṣdar (verbal noun) is accusative by exception, and that from which the exception is made is the generality of states, i.e. "it will remain a doubt in every state except the state of their hearts being cut to pieces".

harrat-mujtaba:111-111.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «بأن لهم الجنة» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «اشترى». The clause «يقاتلون» is resumptive. «وعدًا»: a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an implied verb. The preposition «عليه» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «حقا», and «حقا» is a naʿt (adjective) of «وعدًا». The preposition in «التوراة» is attached to a naʿt of «وعدًا». «ومن أَوْفى»: the wāw is resumptive, «من» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and «أوفى» is the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:112-112.t: «التائبون»: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "they"; what follows it belongs to the category of multiple khabars. The preposition «بالمعروف» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «الآمرون». «لحدود»: the lām is redundant (zāʾida), for strengthening, because the governing word «الحافظون» is secondary (farʿ), and «حدود» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:113-113.t: The noun of kāna is the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يستغفروا», and the preposition «للنبي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). The wāw in «ولو» is circumstantial; it conjoins to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "it was not for them to seek forgiveness in any state, even in this state", and this is for exhausting all states. The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, and the clause is a ḥāl from «المشركين». «أولي» is the khabar of kāna, accusative with yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural. «من بعد ما تبين»: the preposition is attached to «يستغفروا»; «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct); the clause «تبيَّن» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative. The maṣdar «أنهم أصحاب» is the fāʿil (agent) of «تبيَّن».

harrat-mujtaba:114-114.t: The preposition «لأبيه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (verbal noun) (استغفار), and «إلا» is for restriction. The preposition «عن موعدة» is attached to the khabar (predicate) of kāna. The two objects of «وعد» are the attached and the detached pronouns. The clause «فلما تبين» is conjoined to the clause «وما كان استغفار». The maṣdar «أنه عدو» is the fāʿil (agent) of «تبين», and the preposition «لله» is attached to «عدو».

harrat-mujtaba:115-115.t: The lām in «ليضل» is the lām of denial (juḥūd), and the verb is accusative by a concealed «أنْ»; the genitive maṣdar (verbal noun) is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of kāna, implied as "intending". «إذ هداهم»: an adverbial noun indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:116-116.t: The clause «له مُلك» is the khabar (predicate) of inna, and the clause «يحيي» is a second khabar. The clause «وما لكم من دون الله من ولي» is conjoined to the clause «إن الله له ملك». The preposition «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar, and the preposition «من دون» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «ولي». «ولي» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and «مِنْ» is redundant (zāʾida) because it enters an indefinite noun and is preceded by a negation.

harrat-mujtaba:117-117.t: The clause «لقد تاب» is the answer to an implied oath, with no grammatical position. The relative noun is a naʿt (adjective). «من بعد ما كاد يزيغ قلوب فريق منهم»: the preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «اتبعوه»; «ما» is maṣdariyya; «كاد» is an abrogating past verb, and its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct). The clause «يزيغ قلوب» is the khabar (predicate) of kāna [Translator's note: the source says "kāna", though the verb discussed is «كاد»]. The preposition «منهم» is attached to a naʿt of «فريق». The clause «ثم تاب» is conjoined to the clause «تاب». The clause «إنه بهم رءوف» is parenthetical.

harrat-mujtaba:118-118.t: The preposition «وعلى الثلاثة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the preceding «تاب», and this preposition and its genitive noun is conjoined to the preposition and its genitive noun «عليهم». «حتى» is inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya). «إذا» is adverbial and conditional, attached to its implied apodosis: "they took refuge in Him", and the clause after «حتى» is resumptive. «ما» in «بما رحبت» is maṣdariyya, and the genitive maṣdar (verbal noun) is attached to «ضاقت». «أن لا ملجأ من الله إلا إليه»: «أنْ» is lightened from the heavy form, and its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); «لا» is the lā of generic negation, and its noun is indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa; the interpreted maṣdar stands in place of the two objects of «ظن». The preposition «من الله» is attached to the khabar (predicate) of «لا»; «إلا» is for restriction; the preposition «إليه» is attached to the "being" (istiqrār) to which the khabar is attached. The clause «ثم تاب» is conjoined to the implied apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), i.e. "they took refuge in Him, then He turned to them".

harrat-mujtaba:120-120.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يتخلفوا» is the noun of kāna, and the preposition «لأهل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of kāna. The preposition «من الأعراب» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «مَنْ». The maṣdar «بأنهم لا يصيبهم» is genitive by the bāʾ, attached to the khabar. «موطئا»: a mīm-maṣdar, mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) in the sense of "they tread a treading". «إلا» is for restriction. The clause «كتب» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from «ظمأ» and what is conjoined to it, i.e. "no thirst afflicts them except as written". The pronoun in «به» is singular, even though several things precede it, treating it like a demonstrative, i.e. "a righteous deed is written for them by that". A ḥāl from an indefinite noun is permissible because it is preceded by a negation.

harrat-mujtaba:121-121.t: The clause «كتب» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «واديا»; a ḥāl from an indefinite noun is permissible because it is preceded by a negation. «أحسن» is the second object, and «ما» is a relative, muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:122-122.t: The lām in «لينفروا» is for denial (juḥūd), and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of kāna, its implied form being "intending". «كافة»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «ينفروا». The clause «فلولا نفر» is resumptive; «لولا» is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ). The preposition «من كل» is attached to «نفر», and the preposition «منهم» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «فرقة». «إذا رجعوا» is a pure adverb attached to «ينذر». The clause «لعلهم يحذرون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:123-123.t: The preposition «من الكفار» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الذين», and the preposition «فيكم» is attached to a ḥāl from «غلظة».

harrat-mujtaba:124-124.t: «ما» is redundant (zāʾida), and «إذا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the meaning of the apodosis, i.e. "some of them say, when…". «أيكم»: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct); the demonstrative is the fāʿil (agent), and «إيمانا» is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «وهم يستبشرون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in «فزادتهم».

harrat-mujtaba:125-125.t: «رجسا» is the second object, and the preposition «إلى رجسهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «رجسا». The clause «وهم كافرون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «ماتوا».

harrat-mujtaba:126-126.t: The hamza is for interrogation and the wāw is a conjunction; the clause is conjoined to the preceding conditional clause, with no grammatical position. The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أنهم يفتنون» is the object of «رأى». «مرة» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The clause «ولا هم يذكرون» is conjoined to the clause «يتوبون», in the position of the nominative.

harrat-mujtaba:127-127.t: «ما» is redundant (zāʾida). «أحد» is the fāʿil (agent) of «يراكم», and «مِنْ» is redundant. The maṣdar (verbal noun) «بأنهم قوم» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «صرف». The clause «هَلْ يَرَاكُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ» is the content of speech (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied verb of saying, and this saying is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of «نظر», i.e. "saying: does anyone see you". The clause «صرف الله» is resumptive, and the clause «لا يفقهون» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قوم».

harrat-mujtaba:128-128.t: The clause «لقد جاءكم» is the answer to an implied oath. The preposition «من أنفسكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «رسول». «عَزِيزٌ عليه ما عَنِتُّمْ»: «عزيز» is a naʿt of «رسول»; the preposition «عليه» is attached to «عزيز»; «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is the fāʿil (agent) of «عزيز». «حريص»: a third naʿt, and the preposition «عليكم» is attached to «حريص».

harrat-mujtaba:129-129.t: The clause «فإن تولَّوا» is conjoined to the clause {جَاءَكُمْ}, with no grammatical position. «حسبي الله»: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate). «لا» is the lā of generic negation, «إله» is its noun, «إلا» is for restriction, and the khabar is omitted, its implied form being "deserving of worship". «هو» is a badal (substitute) from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in the omitted khabar. The clause of transcendence (tanzīh) is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the word of majesty (Allah). The clause «عليه توكلت» is a second ḥāl, and the clause «وهو رب» is conjoined to the clause «عليه توكلت».

harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: «براءة من الله»: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "this is a disavowal"; the preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «براءة», and the preposition «إلى الذين» is attached to a second naʿt of «براءة». The preposition «من المشركين» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the omitted referring pronoun, i.e. "you made a covenant with them, they being from the polytheists".

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: The clause «فسيحوا» is conjoined to the clause «هذه براءة», with no grammatical position. «أربعة» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «سيحوا». The interpreted maṣdar «أنكم غير معجزي» takes the place of the two objects of علم, and the second interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to the preceding interpreted maṣdar.

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: His words «وأذان»: the wāw is a conjunction; «أذان» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "and this is an announcement", and the clause is conjoined to the clause «هذه براءة», with no grammatical position. The preposition «من الله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «أذان», and the preposition «إلى الناس» is attached to a second naʿt of «أذان»; «يوم» [Translator's note: the source calls it «الجار», a preposition and its genitive noun] is attached to a third naʿt of «أذان». The interpreted maṣdar «أن الله بريء» is accusative by removal of the preposition, the bāʾ. His words «ورسوله»: the wāw is a conjunction, and a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, i.e. "and His Messenger is likewise free"; the clause is conjoined to the single word «بريء», in the position of the nominative, as a case of conjoining a clause to a single word. Thus two things were predicated of Allah: the first, His being free of the polytheists, and the second, His Messenger's being free. The clause «فإن تبتم» is resumptive. The interpreted maṣdar «أنكم غير معجزي» takes the place of the two objects of علم. The clause «وبشِّر» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: «إلا الذين»: excepted, connected (muttaṣil), from «الذين عاهدتم». The preposition «من المشركين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the implied (muqaddar) referring pronoun. «نقص» takes two objects: the kāf and «شيئًا». The clause «فأتموا» is resumptive, and the preposition «إلى مدتهم» is attached to a ḥāl from «عهدهم».

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: The conditional clause is resumptive. «إذا» is adverbial and conditional, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the meaning of the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), not to the apodosis itself, because what comes after the fāʾ does not govern what precedes it. «حيث» is an adverb of place, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, attached to «اقتلوا». The wāw in «وجدتموهم» is for lengthening (ishbāʿ). «كل مرصد» is accusative by removal of the preposition (على). The conditional clause «فإن تابوا» is conjoined to the conditional clause before it.

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: «أحد»: the fāʿil (agent) of an omitted verb explained by what follows it, and the preposition «من المشركين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «أحد»; the clause «استجارك» is explicative. «مأمنه» is a second object. The interpreted maṣdar «بأنهم قوم» is genitive, attached to the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «ذلك», and the clause «ذلك بأنهم قوم» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: «كيف»: an interrogative noun, a ḥāl (circumstantial). «يكون» is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb; the preposition «للمشركين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate), and the adverb «عند الله» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «عهد». «الذين» is excepted, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the accusative. His words «فما استقاموا لكم فاستقيموا لهم»: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «ما» is a conditional noun, an adverb of time attached to استقاموا; the implied form is: "at whatever time they are upright with you, be upright with them". The clause «فما استقاموا» is conjoined to the ṣila (relative clause) before it.

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: «كيف»: an interrogative noun, a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "how can you not fight them?" The wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); the clause «وإن يظهروا» is a ḥāl from the wāw in the implied (muqaddar) «تقاتلونهم». His words «إلا»: a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «يرضونكم» is resumptive, and the clause «وأكثرهم فاسقون» is conjoined to the verbal clause «تأبى قلوبهم».

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: The clause «إنهم ساء» is resumptive; «ما» is a relative noun, the fāʿil (agent) of ساء, and the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, i.e. "their deeds".

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: The clause «لا يرقبون» is a second khabar (predicate) of «إن» in the previous verse. «هم» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position, and the clause «وأولئك هم المعتدون» is conjoined to the clause «لا يرقبون».

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: The clause «فإن تابوا» is resumptive. His words «فإخوانكم»: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «إخوانكم» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "then they are your brothers"; the preposition «في الدين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) إخوانكم because of the verbal meaning in it; the clause «فهم إخوانكم» is the apodosis, in the position of the jussive. The clause «ونفصل» is resumptive, and the clause «يعلمون» is a naʿt (adjective) of قوم.

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: The clause «وإن نكثوا» is conjoined to the clause {فَإِنْ تَابُوا}. The clause «إنهم لا أيمان لهم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «أئمة الكفر», and the clause «لعلهم ينتهون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: «ألا»: a particle of offering and urging (ʿarḍ wa-taḥḍīḍ). The clause «وهم بدءوكم» is conjoined to the clause «هَمُّوا». «أول مرة»: an adverb of time. The clause «فالله أحق» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied (muqaddar) condition, i.e. "if you fear anyone, then Allah is more deserving". The clause «إن كنتم مؤمنين» is resumptive, and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: «يعذِّبهم»: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied (muqaddar) condition, and its object.

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: «أم» is the disconnected one (munqaṭiʿa), and it is construed as "rather" plus the hamza. The interpreted maṣdar «أن تُتْرَكوا» takes the place of the two objects of حسب. His words «ولَمَّا يعلم»: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and a particle that makes jussive, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm). The preposition «منكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «جاهدوا», and the preposition «من دون» is attached to the second object of «اتخذ». «ما» in his words «بما تعملون» is maṣdariyya, and the genitive interpreted maṣdar is attached to «خبير».

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: The interpreted maṣdar «أن يعمروا» is the noun of kāna, and the preposition «للمشركين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) its khabar (predicate). «شاهدين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the polytheists, and the two prepositions «على أنفسهم» and «بالكفر» are attached to «شاهدين». The clause «وهم خالدون» is conjoined to «حبطت أعمالهم», in the position of the nominative.

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: «إنما»: a restraining particle and the restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa), with no governing effect. The clause «فعسى أولئك أن يكونوا» is conjoined to the clause «إنما يعمر». «عسى» is a past abrogating verb (nāsikh), and «أولئك» is its noun; the interpreted maṣdar «أن يكونوا» is the khabar (predicate) of عسى.

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: The preposition «كمن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a second object of «جعل», and the clause «لا يستوون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: «الذين»: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), whose khabar (predicate) is «أعظم», and «درجة» is a tamyīz (specification); the adverb «عند» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أعظم». «هم» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position, and the clause «وأولئك هم الفائزون» is conjoined to «أعظم», as a case of conjoining a clause to a single word.
